package.name: jetrover_arm_control
package.description: ROS 2 control for the Hiwonder JetRover's 4-DOF arm and gripper: wraps the STM32 board's serial bus-servo protocol and exposes it as per-joint topics. Ported and trimmed from SINRG-Lab/industryxr-robot's sinrg_robot_sdk package for real-hardware IRobotPlant integration with the teleoperation research platform.
